target_customer: Retail investors at founding; later brokerages, advisors and AI agents buying verified investment methodology
problem: Retail investors lacked access to data driven strategies; Delphia pooled users' data to power an algorithmic fund, and later Tilt targets news exposure and methodology for portfolios.
business_model: Fee based investment management (about 2 percent per BetaKit), later software and API for portfolio exposure
product_category: Fintech, algorithmic investing and AI investment tools

founders.name: Andrew Peek
founders.role: Founder and CEO (Agora Intelligence, maker of Tilt)
previous_startups: Delphia (built and sold a systematic hedge fund to Acadian)

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a data-driven quantitative fund with consumer data aggregation, plus the regulatory structure of an asset manager, was hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: The data pooling idea depended on user signup and was copyable; the regulated fund structure added some difficulty.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Robo advisors did not copy the data pooling idea; Delphia later exited asset management and sold its hedge fund to Acadian (YC page), with no date found.

market_need_then: The March 2018 Cambridge Analytics scandal made data ownership topical the day after the batch finished; actual retail demand for the product was uncertain, with a 100,000 pre-registered user target gating launch.

branding.domain_note: Used tilt.io, which now redirects to tilt.now (308 redirect).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and urgent: 'Your Portfolio's Exposure to Current Events'

rebrands.why: Delphia exited asset management; Tilt began as one of three spinouts (YC page). Reason for the name not stated.

branding.community_and_virality: Delphia's gated launch and its 2022 data token drew crypto press (Cointelegraph, Blockworks), but no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Delphia got broad fintech and crypto press around the $60M raise, but the brand was dropped and another unrelated company also trades as Tilt, which clouds search.

pivots.from: Retail data pooling investment app with a rewards token
pivots.to: Exit from asset management, sale of hedge fund to Acadian, then Tilt and InvestOS methodology tools
pivots.why: Not stated; exact timing of the exit unknown, date shown is the Series A that funded the token plan.

outcome_analysis: Delphia graduated YC in Winter 2018 with a consumer data-for-investing model and raised a reported $60M Series A in June 2022 led by Multicoin, riding the data DAO trend. It later left asset management after selling its fund to Acadian and reappeared as Tilt, a much smaller team selling AI portfolio tools with a 2025 seed. The path shows a stalled original model and a pivot, but sources do not give causes.
notes: The 2025 seed of $7.1M led by Portage and Lerer Hippeau was reported by a search summary citing Fintech.ca and a Seedtable entry dated 2025-09; I did not open either article, so treat it as moderately certain. Conflicting database entries not recorded: Series B of $10M (2022-12), $15M (2024-05), $18M (2024-08), and a $3.4M Series B-II (2025-07); totals range from $38M (CB Insights) to $86M (Seedtable). Press says the total reached $80M after the Series A. The pre-seed in 2018-02 comes from Seedtable only. Competitors with dated sources near January 2018 were not found; the only competitor material was from 2026 comparisons, so the list is empty. The YC page lists Peek and van der Linden, which may not be the complete original Delphia founding team. Unrelated companies named Tilt exist.
